The dummy FASTQ files and the Bash result (`sorted_bash`) from Problem 1 must exist in
`IBS7048_2026/` at the repository root before knitting this file.

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
# Run every chunk inside IBS7048_2026 (same folder as the Bash script)
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = normalizePath("../IBS7048_2026"))
```

```{r wd}
basename(getwd())   # working directory is IBS7048_2026
```
